page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores utilizing hyper-threading. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also register poor throughput. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by Geekbench and PassMark multi-core CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains moderate, with uncached read speeds reaching 61.2 GB/sec and write speeds at 47.14 GB/sec, though overall PassMark memory and database operation scores are positioned in the lower 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.n2.xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that do not demand high single-threaded performance or local storage. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and average multi-core scaling, this instance is best suited for general-purpose applications, moderate multi-threaded processing, Redis caching layers, and standard web serving workloads that can leverage the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio without requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
